title: Settings
name: Name
themeHint: Saved on this device only. System follows your phone's setting.
checkinBody: Print the QR posters for the doors and review guest check-ins.
loadError: We could not load the team. Reload the page to try again.
noHousekeepers: No housekeeper yet. Add one by email and they can sign in with a link.
addHelp: We email them a sign-in link. They only see their jobs, periodic care, laundry, maintenance, petty cash, assets and apartments.
invited: Invite sent. They can sign in from the email.
addedExisting: Added. They already have an account, so they can sign in with their email now.
activeHint: Switch off to stop them signing in without removing them
removeBody: They will no longer be able to open the app. Their past work, notes and reports stay. You can add them again later.
